description: Compiler macro that declares the events a component can emit and returns a typed `emit` function.
`defineEmits<{ save: [id: number] }>()` describes the argument list of every event.
Template (and Options API) way to emit an event: `$emit('remove')` / `this.$emit('remove')`.
`@remove="fn"` is compiled into an `onRemove` prop, so listeners can be passed as props in tests or render functions.
